name: Judas swing / Power of 3
source: 2016 Mentorship: Impulse Price Swings & Market Protraction; time-of-day reference (Power of 3, midnight open)
summary: Each day tends to accumulate (Asia), manipulate (a false move after midnight New York: the Judas swing), then distribute in the real direction. On a bullish day, buy the false drop below the midnight open in the London killzone.
steps: Know the daily bias before the session (bullish or bearish day).
Mark the New York midnight opening price and the Asian range.
After midnight, expect a false move against the bias (protraction): on a bullish day, a drop below the midnight open, often through the Asian low.
In the London killzone, wait for the reversal: displacement back in the bias direction.
Enter at the order block or FVG the reversal leaves, below the midnight open (above it for shorts).
entry: On a bullish day, at a PD array below the midnight opening price after the Judas swing reverses (mirror for bearish days).
target: The day's draw on liquidity in the bias direction (e.g. the previous day's high on a bullish day).
invalidation: The 'false' move keeps going with displacement: the bias was wrong for today.
checklist: Daily bias was set before the session
Price made a move against the bias after midnight New York
Entry is below the midnight open on a bullish day (above it on a bearish day)
A displacement back in the bias direction happened in the London killzone
Entry is at an order block or FVG
Target is the day's draw on liquidity; reward at least 2:1
